tests: 42 unique balls have distinct abilities and meaningful collection data
Circle collisions exchange momentum, separate penetration and apply one contact hit
Walls and bumpers reflect balls and preserve visible bounds
Every ability simulates to a finite, bounded end in 1v1 and 2v2
Same seed, ball choices and launch angles produce identical battles
Shield absorbs damage and Vampire heals only damage actually dealt
Phoenix revives exactly once and cannot exceed its max health
True team combat has two balls on each side and waits for the full team to fall
Three random offers are unique and collection choice is limited once per match
Reroll is free once per match and cannot replace a committed choice
Round and match settlement remove hearts and pay a reward exactly once
Tied rounds cannot create negative hearts or more than one match payout
Local players always use equal stats, even with hard AI selected
Direct unlocks enforce money and cannot charge for owned balls
Capsule duplicates refund 60 coins and pity grants a new unowned ball
Save sanitization rejects invalid roster data, infinities and unsupported preferences
Profile export/restore retains earned collection and never restores an unfinished match
